note: NVIDIA Video Effects runtime (VFX SDK 1.3.0.0: VideoFrameGeneration, RTX VSR = VideoSuperRes over nvngx_vsr 1.8.3, TrueHDR = RTX Video HDR) from NVIDIA's own PyPI index. PushMPC never redistributes these files: the installer downloads the exact wheel below, checks its SHA-256 (the index publishes the same hash) and extracts only the listed files, each checked against its own SHA-256 and size. The per-file lists were produced on GitHub's runners by .github/workflows/nvidia-vfx.yml (job probe). NVIDIA's licence: NvidiaProprietary (the user accepts it at install, as with the Windows runtime).
